Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard
Precondition: The OrangeHRM demo login page is reachable at the login URL. A valid registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login form is displayed with a Username field, a Password field, and a 'Login' button | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the field labelled 'Username' → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin'; no validation error appears | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the field labelled 'Password' → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters; no validation error appears | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The user is redirected to the dashboard URL (.../dashboard/index) and the 'Dashboard' heading is visible
Expected Result: The user is authenticated and lands on the dashboard with a valid session established.

Title: Verify 'Required' message appears below Username when submitted empty
Precondition: The login page is loaded and both fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed with empty Username and Password fields | 2. Leave the 'Username' field empty → Expected: The Username field remains empty | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the 'Password' field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed directly below the Username field and the form is not submitted
Expected Result: The user remains on the login page with a 'Required' message under the Username field.

Title: Verify 'Required' message appears below Password when submitted empty
Precondition: The login page is loaded and both fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed with empty Username and Password fields | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the 'Username' field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Leave the 'Password' field empty → Expected: The Password field remains empty | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed directly below the Password field and the form is not submitted
Expected Result: The user remains on the login page with a 'Required' message under the Password field.

Title: Verify 'Required' message appears under both fields when both submitted empty
Precondition: The login page is loaded and both fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed with empty Username and Password fields | 2. Leave both the 'Username' and 'Password' fields empty → Expected: Both fields remain empty | 3. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed below the Username field and a separate 'Required' message is displayed below the Password field; the form is not submitted
Expected Result: The user remains on the login page with a 'Required' message under each of the two fields.

Title: Verify login fails with 'Invalid credentials' for wrong password
Precondition: A valid account exists with username 'Admin'. The login page is loaded.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the 'Username' field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'wrongPass999' into the 'Password' field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error banner is displayed and the user remains on the login page
Expected Result: Authentication is rejected and an 'Invalid credentials' banner is shown; no session is established.

Title: Verify login fails with 'Invalid credentials' for unknown username (no enumeration)
Precondition: No account exists with username 'nonexistentUser42'. The login page is loaded.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'nonexistentUser42' into the 'Username' field → Expected: The Username field shows 'nonexistentUser42' | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the 'Password' field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error banner is displayed; the message does not indicate that the username is unknown
Expected Result: Authentication is rejected with the same generic 'Invalid credentials' banner used for wrong passwords.

Title: Verify whitespace-only entries do not pass validation as non-empty
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter three space characters into the 'Username' field → Expected: The Username field contains only whitespace | 3. Enter three space characters into the 'Password' field → Expected: The Password field contains only whitespace (masked) | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: Login is rejected — either a 'Required' message appears under the fields or an 'Invalid credentials' banner is shown; the user is not authenticated
Expected Result: Whitespace-only input is treated as invalid; no authentication occurs.

Title: Verify password field masks input and is not exposed in the URL
Precondition: The login page is loaded over HTTPS.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and confirm the URL scheme is HTTPS → Expected: The page loads over HTTPS | 2. Enter 'admin123' into the 'Password' field → Expected: The Password field renders masked characters (dots), not plain text | 3. Enter 'Admin' into the 'Username' field and click 'Login' → Expected: The user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard | 4. Inspect the resulting page URL → Expected: The URL does not contain the password value or the username as a query parameter
Expected Result: The password is masked during entry and never appears in the URL.

Title: Verify 'Forgot your password?' link navigates to the password recovery page
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed and a 'Forgot your password?' link is visible | 2. Click the 'Forgot your password?' link → Expected: The browser navigates to the password recovery page (.../auth/requestPasswordResetCode) | 3. Observe the recovery page → Expected: The 'Reset Password' page is displayed with a Username field and a 'Reset Password' button, and no error is shown
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the password recovery page without error.

Title: Verify dashboard displays the authenticated user's basic information after login
Precondition: A valid account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The user is on the login page.
Steps: 1. Log in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' → Expected: The user is redirected to the dashboard URL | 2. Observe the top navigation user dropdown → Expected: The logged-in user's profile name is displayed in the user dropdown area | 3. Observe the main dashboard content area → Expected: The 'Dashboard' heading and standard dashboard widgets (such as 'Quick Launch' and 'Time at Work') are rendered without errors
Expected Result: The dashboard loads showing the authenticated user's own basic information and standard widgets.

Title: Verify direct navigation to dashboard URL without a session redirects to login
Precondition: No authenticated session exists (browser has no valid session cookie / user is logged out).
Steps: 1. Ensure no active session by clearing cookies or using a fresh browser context → Expected: No session cookie is present | 2. Navigate directly to the dashboard URL → Expected: The application redirects the browser to the login page (.../auth/login) | 3. Observe the resulting page → Expected: The login form is displayed and no dashboard content is shown
Expected Result: Unauthenticated access to the dashboard is redirected to the login page.
